title: interact
summary: MSUI's shared world interaction path covers units and dynamic GameObjects: per-frame ray picking, world-collision occlusion, nearest unit/GameObject arbitration, left selection, right-click service/use routing, GameObject template-name tooltip ownership, and Benilla's GENERIC data[1] highlight opt-in. Focused laws/source wiring pass; live dense-scene and representative-object verification remains.

openItems.text: GameObjects and doodads are not mouse-pickable: PickUnit iterates units only, so right-click-to-use a chest/vein/mailbox in the world never happens from the cursor (UseGameObject is reachable only via selection-driven/dev paths)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: Dynamic GameObjects are ray-picked with world-collision occlusion and nearest-unit arbitration; right-click dispatches UseGameObject, and the shared world tooltip uses the queried template name. GENERIC objects additionally honor template data[1] highlight eligibility.
